_comment: Copy this somewhere OUTSIDE the repo and point HOUSECARL_HARNESS_CONFIG at it. This repo is the tool and is meant to be shared; a config naming your MO2 instance, profile and drive layout is a fact about YOUR mod setup and belongs with it. (A copy named harness.local.json beside the harness also works and is gitignored, but keeping it out of the tree is cleaner.) Use FORWARD slashes: Windows accepts them and a lone backslash is an invalid JSON escape. Every key is optional — a probe only requires the ones it uses. Precedence: the probe's own flags (--instance, --profile, --game, --roots) beat the environment (HOUSECARL_MO2_INSTANCE / _MO2_PROFILE / _GAME_PATH / _DOWNLOAD_POOL / _SEVENZIP / _SEARCH_ROOTS), which beat this file. Exception: "instance" here is never used as a default — a probe given no --instance (or HOUSECARL_MO2_INSTANCE) refuses with instance-not-explicit — and "game"/"profile" here are used only when the run's instance is this one. HOUSECARL_MO2_INSTANCE counts only when set for the run, not persisted at User/Machine level (instance-env-persistent).
